messages:
oncall-bot: [INCIDENT] P1 detected — multi-region latency spike affecting Redwood API (hosted). Automatic pager to #eng-oncall and incident channel created: #incident-2210004567. See auto-summary: increased 95th latency west1/eu-west, spike in 503s.
Alex Li: I picked this up, currently investigating router backpressure + model pool queuing. I need to hand off at 18:30 PT. Paging still on. Customers seeing intermittent 503s and elevated token latency. @Priya can you take driver at 18:30? I'll stay on comms for a few mins while we swap.
Priya Nair: I can take driver at 18:30 PT but heads-up — I have a 5min calendar hold from 18:40-18:45. If a page hits in that window please escalate to Kevin or Jamie as backup.
Jamie Ortiz: I can own comms immediately. I'll post customer-facing updates to #customers-status and maintain the incident blurb. Do we have the current runbook link for API 503? I only see an older copy in bookmarks.
Alex Li: Runbook (latest): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/api-503. Key checklist: 1) check router and ingress queue lengths, 2) inspect model pool health and KV cache, 3) disable burst autoscale if it causes thrash, 4) route to fallback model if error_rate threshold hit. Quick commands: ```
# list pools with high latency
rwdctl pool list --region west1 --filter latency>100
# inspect processes on pool node
rwdctl pool ps --pool-id p-west1-3
```
Priya Nair: @Jamie thanks. Plan: I take driver at 18:30, run the pool checks, and apply short throttles to non-critical routes if queues stay high. @Kevin can you stand up as backup driver from 18:40-18:50? If pages land while I'm in that meeting, please take the bridge.
Kevin Zhang: I can cover 18:40-18:50. If paged I'll join the bridge and run `rwdctl pool ps --region west1` immediately and post the output here. Also happy to escalate to Eng Platform if we need kernel-level kernel tuning.
SRE Rotation Bot: Reminder: on handoff, update incident channel topic and execute the handoff command. Example: `/handoff driver=@Priya comms=@Jamie until=18:50` — this toggles the rota and updates PagerDuty routing.
Jamie Ortiz: Acknowledged. I'll update the channel topic and push a public blurb. Draft public update: "We are investigating elevated latency impacting API requests in some regions. Our engineers are actively working on mitigation. No data loss expected. Next update in 15 minutes." Any changes? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Alex Li: Looks good. One more operational rule: if latency > 500ms and error rate > 5% we trigger fallback to small-1 model to preserve availability. I'll apply temporary policy: `route-policy set fallback=small-1 when error_rate>0.05` once Priya confirms driver takeover.
oncall-bot: Action queued: execute handoff at 18:30.
Priya Nair: Taking driver now (18:30). I'll post KV/cache checks in ~2m. Jamie, lock the public blurb and ping account team for affected customers.
Priya Nair: KV cache hit rate for suspect prefixes: 92% — probably not the root cause. Observed queue length spike on model pool p-west1-3. Starting controlled throttle on non-critical routes and raising priority traffic. Posting `rwdctl pool ps` output in a sec.
Jamie Ortiz: Posted update to #customers-status and messaged top accounts. Pinned runbook link and the key commands in this incident channel. I'll be the comms owner while driving is with Priya (and Kevin as backup).
Alex Li: Thanks. I'll be reachable for ~10 more minutes. If anything infra-level is needed escalate to Eng Platform (cc @Kevin). I'll remove myself from the oncall rota after I drop.
Kevin Zhang: On standby for 18:40-18:50. If nothing urgent I will hand back to Priya at 18:50 and note it in the channel.
oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: driver=Priya Nair (effective 18:30), comms=Jamie Ortiz, backup driver=Kevin Zhang (18:40-18:50). Pages routed according to new temporary policy.
Priya Nair: Noted. Running additional pool diagnostics now; will post findings and any mitigation steps.
Priya Nair: Run output summary: queue depth high (avg 120), several model workers in recovery loop. I've drained non-critical queue and temporarily limited burst autoscale. Error rate reduced from 6.2% -> 2.1% after throttle, latency trending down.
Jamie Ortiz: Updated status: "Mitigations in progress; error rate decreasing and latency improving. Team applied temporary throttles and are monitoring."
Alex Li: Great work. If error_rate stays <3% for 15m we close the P1 and move to postmortem. Thanks everyone for the smooth handoff.
Kevin Zhang: Handed back to Priya at 18:50 — leaving final note and removing temporary rota.
oncall-bot: Incident action: P1 remains active. Last log entry recorded."
